lines.text: At night her beloved knocks and asks her to open, though she has already taken off her robe.
She rises to open, her hands dripping with myrrh, but he is still waiting at the door.

wrong_details.wrong: he is still waiting at the door

lines.text: The watchmen beat her and take her cloak, and she asks the daughters of Jerusalem to tell him she is sick with love.
She describes him as outstanding among ten thousand, with a head of purest gold and arms of silver.

wrong_details.true: arms are rods of gold set with beryl

lines.text: She tells the daughters he has gone down to his garden, and she says she belongs to him.
